title: Have diaplay_epoch_time() take an nstime_t as an argument.
description:
And have it handle all time stamp precision values from 0 to 9.

Do that by making it just a wrapper for display_signed_time(); both
routines should just display the secs and nsecs values.

(The difftime() call serves no purpose:

* difftime() exists in order to allow the encoding of times in time_ts
in an arbitrary fashion, such that subtracting their numerical values
won't necessarily return a difference in seconds, and to allow a
difference in seconds to be calculated.  See the C89 rationale at
http://www.lysator.liu.se/c/rat/d12.html#4-12-2-2.

* Howeveer, on UN*Xes and in the Visual Studio C library, time_t is just
a count of "seconds since the Epoch", so difftime(<time_t>, 0) just
converts the integral time_t to a double.)
